facts.fact: Le Soleil's live blog says that on 24 February 2025 at Diamniadio "le gouvernement du Sénégal lance" (launches) the New Deal technologique, its roadmap for digital transformation, at a ceremony where President Bassirou Diomaye Faye gave the address; no adopting act is named.

Le Soleil says that on the sidelines of the 24 February 2025 launch the names of the 20 members of the Conseil national du "New Deal technologique" were announced; the live blog does not state the act or mandate creating the council.

Le Soleil's live blog quotes the Secretary General of the Government saying the strategy is aligned with the portfolio of priority projects and reforms "avec une déclinaison décennale et quinquennale" (ten-year and five-year breakdown), and quotes targets of 500 labelled startups, 100,000 digital graduates, 95% connectivity and a 15% GDP contribution; no cost is given.

systems.owner: Government of Senegal; Ministry of Communication, Telecommunications and Digital Affairs (Alioune Sall)
systems.tiers: national; economy and administration (single citizen counter, universal internet, startups, sovereignty)

systems.system: Conseil national du New Deal technologique
